lore.title: Lore Letter
paragraphs: Started as a Java modder in 2016 and never really stopped - just gradually shifted toward the professional side. Since 2019 I've been deep in Bedrock: entity AI, custom animations, art pipelines, and the tooling that makes all of it less painful.

I work across the full stack of an add-on - behaviors, scripting, modeling, textures, and the build systems that tie it together. Currently at Tsunami Studios while contributing to unannounced work at Simply Brilliant.

experience.projects: Dragons, Be a Mob, Mutants, Into The Wild, Backrooms
